command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/usr/local/bin:/opt/conda/bin:$PATH HOME=/tmp TMPDIR=/tmp
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /tmp/out
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 08bbeb45c2aea944c8c9a491b56c097479fc33af0e5ed7ff4b14b99a0dfd6bbf fetch.py; } > scripts.sha256
sha256sum -c scripts.sha256 || { echo 'FAIL: a staged script does not match its pin'; exit 1; }
python3 -u fetch.py 2>&1 | tee /tmp/out/fetch.log
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = 0 && grep -q 'FETCH OK' /tmp/out/fetch.log || { echo 'FAIL: fetch'; exit 1; }
